    //==
    // # Derived functions for the IQuantity interface
    //
    // Bodies for the IQuantity interface declared in `quantities.concepts.plato`.
    // Ordering, interpolation, Double and Half all come from the `core-*` /
    // `algebra-*` libraries via
    // the inherited interfaces; only what is specific to the Amount projection is
    // added here. Pure expressions only; all values are immutable.

    //==
    // # IQuantity
    //
    // A one-dimensional measured amount (IValue, IComparable, IHashable, IAdditive,
    // IScalable, IInterpolatable) with an Amount projected to a raw Number.
    // Ordering (Lesser/Greater/Clamp/Between), MidPoint, LerpClamped, Double and
    // Half all come from CoreAlgebra via the inherited interfaces; only the
    // Amount-based sign/zero predicates and the same-type absolute value are
    // added here. IQuantity is deliberately not IArithmetic (multiplying two
    // quantities yields a different type), so no product helper is offered.

    // True when the underlying amount is exactly zero. (IQuantity is not INumerical,
    // so CoreAlgebra's IsZero does not apply.)
    IsZero(self: IQuantity): Boolean
        => self.Amount == 0.0;
